description: Bootstrap stage. Applies BEFORE T0. Seeds mock_data baseline into the orchestrator world and places all canonical static artifacts on /workspace. Persona files, yard pre-haul instructions, Cummins TSB-247B service bulletin PDF, Hamilton order confirmation PDF, Rockland Marine work-order template DOCX, catch log / engine log / finances seed CSVs, and three seed emails (Co-op weekly settlement, Yard pre-haul, Cummins monthly bulletin summary). API seeds for Hamilton inventory, calendar events (haul-out + ortho), Cummins service bulletins, and the six existing MEMORY.md contacts. No silent drifts here — those start at stage 1. [DESCOPED: removed loud seeds for hamilton-marine-api + cummins-service-bulletins-api (no mock server present).]

body.subject: Eileen C haul-out Wed Dec 9 prep checklist
body.body: Alden — please deliver Eileen C to the yard slip by 4 PM Tuesday Dec 8. Pre-haul: (1) fuel tank below half, (2) batteries pulled, (3) all gear stripped from deck and cabin. Lift Wed Dec 9 at 08:00 ET sharp. 3-day turnaround. Our lead diesel mechanic on the diagnostic. Bring any parts you want installed. Work order form attached.
